88' Jacobo Ramon (Como) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
87' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.

84' It doesn’t look good for Nesta Elphege (Parma); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
84' The corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is hurriedly cleared.
83' The corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is cleared away by the defence. Como have been awarded a corner kick.

82' Alvaro Morata (Como) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Zion Suzuki is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
82' The substitution has been made. Sergi Roberto (Como) has replaced Martin Baturina.
82' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas will be replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).

78' Enrico Delprato (Parma) is flagged for offside.
77' Nesta Elphege (Parma) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
76' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Parma players look gutted.
75' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Parma players aren’t happy.

68' Maximo Perrone (Como) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.

65' Alberto Moreno (Como) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

58' 1 - 0 Jesus Rodriguez feeds the ball through to Alberto Moreno (Como), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly drills it into the roof of the net! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
57' Martin Baturina (Como) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the right post!

46' Assane Diao (Como) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Zion Suzuki, who tips the ball around the post. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.

25' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

15' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jean Butez.

14' Jacobo Ramon (Como) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
14' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
14' Assane Diao (Como) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Como.
11' A big rebound finds it way to Martin Baturina (Como), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players.

6' Martin Baturina (Como) takes the corner.
6' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.

4' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
